ns0:svg.ns0:title: Where the six largest sending economies contributed, 2026 Q1
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Ribbons go from the six largest outbound economies to their seven leading destinations and all other destinations. Ribbon width is the sum of public Git pushes and opened pull requests. The United States was the largest destination among these six source economies. The right-side amounts are from these six origins, not worldwide destination totals.
